advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Bound completion_verify_step_floor_min at <=480 (validator maximum) or clamp lo against _VERIFY_STEP_FLOOR_MAX in verify_step_floor so the 480 ceiling cannot be exceeded.
evidence: src/rebar/_config_schema.py:619: `"completion_verify_step_floor_min": lambda v, k: _as_int(v, k, minimum=1),` — no maximum bound
completion.py comment: `480 is retained ONLY as the clamp MAX so no ticket exceeds today's ceiling.`
advisory.finding: verify_step_floor can exceed the documented hard ceiling of 480 when the operator sets completion_verify_step_floor_min above 480. The clamp is max(lo, min(scaled, 480)); when lo>480 the min() clamps scaled to 480 but the outer max() returns lo, so the floor becomes lo (>480). The config validator only enforces minimum=1 with no maximum, so this is operator-reachable and silently breaks the '480 is retained ONLY as the clamp MAX so no ticket exceeds today's ceiling' invariant stated in the code comment.
advisory.suggested_fix: Either add maximum=480 to the completion_verify_step_floor_min validator, or compute `return min(_VERIFY_STEP_FLOOR_MAX, max(lo, min(scaled, _VERIFY_STEP_FLOOR_MAX)))` so the ceiling always dominates.

scenarios: An operator re-runs the runaway-budget diagnostic sweep and the step-floor knob no longer takes effect (assignment lands on a dead attribute).

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Skip the graduated nudge (return the raw error) when the fallback read_file call returns an 'Error:'-prefixed string on the repeat/truncated paths.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py:239: `return await self.wrapped.call_tool(name, tool_args, ctx, tool) + nudge`
Contrast src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py:188-189: `if isinstance(result, str) and result.startswith("Error:"): return result`
dropped.finding: In _read_file_call the repeat-read cache-miss fallback (`return await self.wrapped.call_tool(...) + nudge`) and the first-read truncated fallback do not apply the 'Error:'-prefix guard that the exact-signature memo path applies (lines 188-189). On the repeat path an 'Error:'-prefixed transient failure gets a graduated nudge string appended to it, unlike the primary memo which returns the raw error untouched.

ABSENCE: no test in test_completion_banking.py / test_completion_token_recovery_heldout.py scripts a finalizer that FAILS the first attempt then SUCCEEDS on the second (returning finalizer=llm_finalizer, certifiable=True) — the retry's success arm
dropped.finding: The finalizer retry-once-then-SUCCEED branch in CompletionAgentStep._finalize is untested. Existing tests cover only finalizer-succeeds-on-attempt-1 and finalizer-fails-BOTH-attempts (test_deterministic_fallback_when_finalizer_fails_twice asserts finalizer_runs==2 → deterministic_fallback). No test drives a first attempt that raises (LLMError/ValueError) or misses coverage validation followed by a SUCCESSFUL second attempt returning an llm_finalizer verdict. A regression in the retry loop (not re-running, reusing a stale result, or wrongly falling through to deterministic_fallback after a recoverable first miss) would pass CI.
dropped.suggested_fix: Add a _StubRunner whose on_finalizer raises (or returns incomplete criteria) on the first single_turn call and returns a full-coverage verdict on the second; assert result.outputs['finalizer'] != 'deterministic_fallback', result.outputs['certifiable'] is True, and runner.finalizer_runs == 2.
